author: Raikkou
body:
Age: 14 (15 on march 27th)

Timezone: GMT+1 (swedish timezone)

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes (although my microphone doesnt work at the moment, I've been trying my best to fix it but without success, though I'm confident that with the right help it should work again)

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? Indeed, mostly server managing (not developer since I don't know how to code yet), though I've also been admin and moderator on a pretty big amount of servers.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? I'm not very self confident, although I'm working on it. Shouldn't affect my moderating too much.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? I could help keeping order on the network, and helping those in need.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? A leader needs to be strong, and good at encouraging people do do their best. I'm not much of a leader type myself, more of someone there to help when needed, help with decisions but never stand in the spotlight myself.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? My experience, my natural need/lust/want to help others.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? The ability to keep cool in any situation, compassion, and a sense of humor.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? Probaly to the end of avicus.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? Send a message to higher staffs, and meanwhile keep freezing the player it's about since it would be the only thing I could do.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? First record/screenshot it if evidence is needed in the future and then ask/tell him/her myself to leave too, if they keep refusing I'd report to a higher staff.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? Firstly I'd always want someone else to record aswell, incase something like that happends, if no one that I KNOW have recorded it too, I'd ask around and see if anyone else had evidence against the person, if there isn't I suppose I'd try to get witnesses?

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I'd first tell them to remove it, and then tell them not to do it again, if they however would do it again I'd report it to higher staffs.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? I'd talk to them to get the full story and then try to give them my point of view.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? It would actually be exciting, like an adventure, I've been on the server for so long and finally actually getting to help it myself (without only recording) would be just awesome.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? Avicus was the second server, ever, that I played on and actually STAYED (I started playing minecraft around 2011). Avicus has been what's made me keep playing minecraft and not just go play other games instead.

Do you speak any other languages than English? I speak fluent swedish and french, and I'm learning german

Do you have anything else to add to your application? I was sceptical if I should actually submit this application, because I'm actually really scared of the interview (I've never done an interview before, most servers just accept me right away o3o), but my friends encouraged me to do it.
